ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Handling of the Alex Pretti Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump Administration's response to the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti, including any potential cover-ups or conflicting statements.
ideas.angle: Follow the Money and Investigate Government Accountability
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti?
How has the Trump Administration responded to the incident?
searches: Trump Administration response to Alex Pretti shooting
ideas.insight: I believe this story has the potential to uncover important information about the Trump Administration's handling of the incident and potential attempts to obscure the truth. By following the money and investigating government accountability, we may be able to shed light on a larger pattern of misconduct.
